etymology.root: แยก yaek — to separate. Si yaek is a crossroads, sam yaek a T. A junction is named after what stands beside it: Yaek Rincome after a hotel that closed, Yaek Sanam Bin after the airport.

text.what: The junction. Chiang Mai directions run from yaek to yaek, and the names outlive the buildings.

text_th.what: ทางแยก การบอกทางในเชียงใหม่วิ่งจากแยกถึงแยก และชื่อแยกอยู่นานกว่าตึก

word.example_gloss: Yaek Rincome — the junction named for a hotel that is gone

kin.as: The one named for a vanished hotel.

text_th.note: written in Thai by this project, in the northern register where it fits; not machine-translated
